cohort: The study included pregnant forced migrants, non-migrants, and resident migrants in the Netherlands whose pregnancy outcomes were recorded in the Dutch perinatal registry from 2014-2019.
finding: Forced migrants in the Netherlands had increased risks of perinatal mortality, small for gestational age infants, and emergency cesarean section compared to non-migrants, and increased risk of SGA compared to resident migrants, despite having lower risks of preterm birth.
mod_finding: The forced migrant group had an increased risk of emergency cesarean section compared to non-migrants and higher rates of planned cesarean section compared to both non-migrants and resident migrants.
